recentItems.title: GBVF Crisis | Craig Wilkinson on how fathers can raise boys who respect women
recentItems.description:
{WARNING: GRAPHIC VISUALS}

Femicide and violence against women remain a devastating reality for families and communities across South Africa. 

But tackling GBV also means looking at the boys we are raising today, and the men they will become. 

So, what role can fathers, families and communities play in raising young men to reject violence and respect women and girls? 

We put this question to Craig Wilkinson, the CEO from Father a Nation who joins us now to discuss how men can play an active role in curbing the ongoing GBV and femicide crisis.

recentItems.title: BOOK REVIEW | South African braai culture this heritage month
recentItems.description:
This Heritage Month and in our book review segment today we're talking about something that is almost sacred in South African culture... the braai! 

But a braai is about far more than putting meat over a fire; it is about gathering, storytelling, recipes passed down, regional flavours, the person who guards the fire, and that very South African ability to turn a meal into an occasion.

Jan Braai's Atmosfire takes us beyond the usual steak and boerewors, exploring everything from breakfast and burgers to seafood, venison, pap, potjies, bread, and even dessert while getting into the techniques behind cooking with fire. 

So, Jan, let's talk about the food, the fire and perhaps most importantly, what the braai says about who we are. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: MUSIC | The duo behind Ingoma Yomshado
recentItems.description:
The joint project by duo Enocs Mae and Keyywav finally making one bed for their sound. 

Its biggest moments, Ithuba Interlude and Ingoma Yomshado, are what happens when Durban's yearning meets Jozi's late-night production fresh and nostalgic at once, like a love letter you have heard before but never in your own language. 

It is R&Bhinca and Soul. For more on this we are joined by Enocs Mae and Keyywav.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
